products.name: The DeLaurenti Wine Flight
products.description: The full flight people...Our new Red Wine, Oregon Pinot Noir, Chianti Classico, Organic Prosecco, Roero Arneis, and our Rosato. A wine for every occasion & a GREAT gift!

products.name: DeLaurenti Prosecco
products.description: Our very own prosecco from just outside Trieste. Crisp, dry and delicious. There is no prosecco season - this wine is good 12 months a year!

products.name: DeLaurenti Roero Arneis DOCG
products.description:
Arneis is Piedmont’s native white, grown for centuries on the same hills that yield Barolo and Barbaresco. By the 1980s it had almost vanished, but a small band of growers nursed it back, and in the ’90s it re-emerged as Roero’s calling card - sometimes dubbed "Barolo bianco," though it needs no comparison to justify its place at the table.

This bottling comes from the sandy slopes of Santo Stefano Roero. It pours a bright straw yellow. The nose suggests fresh fruit and white flowers. On the palate it’s crisp and poised, with stone-fruit flavors giving way to a clean, mineral finish, typical of the Roero landscape.

Think of Arneis as a lively alternative to Sancerre or a Pinot Grigio with more nerve. Chill it lightly and pair with shellfish, grilled trout, or a simple roast chicken. It’s the sort of everyday white that makes summer meals feel complete.

products.name: DeLaurenti Red Wine
products.description: Our newest Washington red blend has arrived! This everyday red is made in the great state of Washington with Italian roots. Crafted in the same way as the great Super Tuscan Tignanello, it consists of 80% Sangiovese, 15% Merlot & 5% Cabernet Franc. The result is a lush, accessible wine with flavors of dark fruit, baking spice & subtle toasted oak. Great on its own, with grilled meats and pasta. Or, with its convenient screw top, its the perfect picnic wine!

products.name: DeLaurenti Rosato 750ml
products.description: A new batch of DeLaurenti Rosato has made it to our shelves! This rose is reminiscent of the roses of Provence, despite being entirely Tuscan Sangiovese. Refreshing, dry, and light with a slightly tart berry finish. This wine will transport you to a sunny afternoon on a breezy Mediterranean beach, no matter what time of year you pop the cork!

products.name: Delaurenti Pinot Noir
products.description: When we decided to bring in another PNW wine under our private label, we knew we wanted it to be Pinot Noir. An elegant, medium-bodied red that would be perfect for any season, and ready for your dinner table any night of the week. Single-vineyard fruit from the Eola-Amity Hills in Oregon, aged in new and used French oak for 18 months, and really fun to drink!

products.name: DeLaurenti Chianti Colli Senesi DOCG
products.description: Our very own Chianti! Hailing from organic vineyards in the town of Montepulciano, this wine is your go-to for any and all pizza, pasta with red sauce, or anything on the grill. Mellow tannins and gorgeous, earthy, red berry notes on the nose. Our Chianti was sourced with our own dinner tables in mind- bring it home to yours today!
